title: Project command-specific exit-code mappings
description:
The schema exposes a global exit-code taxonomy but not the command outcomes that produce each code. Documentation must currently cite runtime classification and direct exits instead of a maintained projection.

Source: `crates/jit/src/schema.rs:520-556`; `crates/jit/src/main.rs:33-247`; `crates/jit/src/output_macros.rs:112-121`; `dev/active/2d109173-plan.md:384-403`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A discoverable generated surface identifies per-command or per-command-family exit codes, including exceptions to the global taxonomy.
- [hard] REQ-02: The projection derives from or is mechanically verified against runtime classification and dispatch sources.
- [hard] REQ-03: Documentation consuming the new surface does not hand-copy per-command exit-code tables.
